insufficient_data_rule: if either target is not met the only permitted verdict is INSUFFICIENT_DATA

req1_preregistration.freeze_mechanism: owner records commit SHA of this file and protocol_hash; any later edit invalidates the freeze and requires a new SHA before new collection

req2_deduplication.analysis_unit: mint (one counted launch per creator wallet)
req2_deduplication.cross_bundle_signature_dedup: key=(signature); keep earliest available_at_ms; report all dropped duplicates

req3_time_and_causality.unknown_source_time_policy: label source_time_unknown; excluded from any decision input and from cycles; counted and reported
req3_time_and_causality.causal_rule: a decision at time t may use only records with available_at_ms <= t and known source_time_ms

req4_causal_criteria.master_reconstructibility_caveat: authentic MASTER frame not reconstructible from TradeEvents alone (USD, holders, creator history missing)

req5_transactions.note: 81 transaction records, 79 distinct signatures; the 80 stated in report 152 is superseded

req6_migration.currently_supported_in_bot_p3_launchlab: unknown_for_migration_states; no migration kind exists in the evidence schema

req7_non_vacuous_tests.cycle_claims_must_be_derived_from: paired buy and sell quote_attempt/pool_snapshot records with executable_confirmed true, never from absent kinds
req7_non_vacuous_tests.negative_cases: synthetic, labelled synthetic=true, never mixed with provenance=live

req8_costs_thresholds.units: integer lamports and atomic token units
req8_costs_thresholds.unknown_cost: cycle excluded from P&L, kept in denominator, reported; exclusions must be <= 20% of cycles
req8_costs_thresholds.fx: SOL native; USD only with strict point-in-time source timestamp
req8_costs_thresholds.profitability_demonstrated_only_if: holdout paired-difference lower 95% bound > 0 AND MASTER total net P&L > 0 AND both targets met AND unknown-cost exclusions <= 20%
req8_costs_thresholds.interval_method: paired cluster bootstrap by creator, 95%, seed declared by owner
